Hi Samir (and Lina),

Thanks again for making time this morning — appreciate the candid product context and the constraints you mentioned on retention and regional routing. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Key needs: sub-100ms tail latency for UI flows, token-level cost reporting, and VPC private deployment for PII workflows.
- Internal owners: Lina will own integration and compliance checks; you mentioned partnering with cloud infra for VPC peering.
- Risks: audit timeline in Q3 and potential need for on-prem evaluation if data residency is required.

Next step: technical deep dive + ops handoff where our infra engineer walks through deployment patterns and a short demo of prefix caching. You were going to confirm a time after checking with Lina. I scheduled two tentative 30-min slots on our side but I noticed we missed the calendar sync — suspecting a timezone mix-up.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (high-level summary).

Can you confirm which of these works, or propose two alternatives (please include timezone):
- Thu Apr 4 2028 10:30–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 4 2028 14:00–14:30 PT

If neither works, please suggest two windows and we'll lock one immediately — small ask: reply with a single confirmed option so we can send a calendar invite (we've been burned by no-shows here and want to make it easy to hold a slot).

Thanks,
Neha
